blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Seeking to consolidate its financial evidence under Article II, the House prosecution panel calls lawyer Alexander Cabrera to testify as a forensic financial expert witness in the Senate impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte. House prosecution Rep. Chel Diokno formally offered Cabrera’s testimony before the Senate impeachment court./dp READ: Hontiveros firm
